sky.title: Sky view
sky.description: See the sun's path over your camera view.
sky.lead: Hold your phone up to see where the sun travels today and on the June and December solstices.
sky.stageLabel: Camera view with the sun path drawn over it

status.idle: Sky view works on a phone or tablet with a camera and a compass. Tap "{start}" to begin. The table below works on any device.
status.requesting: Waiting for permission for the camera and compass…
status.ready: Camera and compass are on. The lines follow where you point your phone.
status.denied: Zonkant has no access to the camera or compass. Allow access in your browser settings, then try again.
status.busy: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.
status.unsupported: This device or browser cannot open a camera or compass. The table below has the sun's direction and height.
status.insecure: The camera only works on a secure (https) page.
status.noSensor: No compass found, so the lines cannot be placed. Try a phone or tablet.

controls.label: Calibration and view
controls.warning: Compass may be off by 10° or more. Point at the sun and tap Calibrate.
controls.belowHorizon: The sun is below the horizon, so there is nothing to point at.
controls.calibrated: Calibrated on the sun. Use the buttons to fine-tune.

table.heading: Sun times as a table
table.caption: Direction and height of the sun at every full hour while it is up
